# Uoink 3.8.0 — Living Library

> A local library for the videos and podcasts you study, that any AI you use can search and cite.

Free, MIT-licensed. No account, no Uoink cloud, no required telemetry. Made by Ryan Biddy (@replayryan), a personal side project.

## Install

Windows 10/11 only. No Mac build scheduled. Unsigned installer, about 390 MB; no admin rights needed. Windows SmartScreen will show a warning: More info → Run anyway. Installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink. Sideload the browser extension from the install; Chrome Web Store listing pending.

- [Install](https://uoink.app/install): helper and extension instructions.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/latest): installer and Claude Desktop .mcpb bundle.
- [3.8.0 release notes](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/tag/v3.8.0): Living Library.
- [Changelog](https://uoink.app/changelog): dated release summaries.

## Capture and library

YouTube: timestamped transcript, screenshots, top comments, channel context, metadata. Also X video and post text, podcast RSS/Atom feeds, web articles, and Reddit threads. Capture with the YouTube button, right-click, Alt+U, or your AI agent. Files are structured Markdown plus a JSON sidecar on your own disk, indexed in one local library.

3.8.0 adds clip search and evidence cards; standing capture for YouTube channels, YouTube playlists, and podcast RSS; MCP library search, item reads, resource templates and prompts; cited range export with speaker labels, chapters and provenance; and chapter navigation where chapters exist. Captures show toast notifications. Entity extraction is opt-in and off by default; the usage meter shows real Anthropic usage; the recall hook is hardened against prompt injection.

The library does not organize, file, or re-shelve itself. The Librarian only proposes; applying is off by default and its quality gate has not passed.

- [Features](https://uoink.app/features): feature details.
- [Sources](https://uoink.app/sources): capture paths.
- [How it works](https://uoink.app/how-it-works): capture to cited corpus.

## AI access

Clipboard paste with transcript and frames works with Claude and ChatGPT. Local MCP exposes 32 tools over stdio and 88 in the HTTP registry, counted from release code. Tested clients: Claude Desktop and Cursor. Cline and Continue are standard-stdio compatibility paths, not individually smoke-tested. Do not claim ChatGPT app MCP support. OpenAPI 3.1 bridges local agents that do not speak MCP.

- [Developers](https://uoink.app/developers): README config, .mcpb setup and tool catalog.
